page_title: WOL 2-3 BAY | Wolfsburg v Bayern Munich 25/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman signals a throw-in for Bayern Munich.
90+2' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) works the corner short.
90+2' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Bayern Munich win a corner.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
87' Manuel Neuer comes off his line to intercept the corner from Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg).
86' Wolfsburg are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
85' Substitution. Mattias Svanberg walks off the pitch and Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) comes on as a substitute.

85' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
84' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) commits a rough foul. Daniel Siebert stops the game and makes a call.
82' Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) gets booked for the first time in this match.
82' 2 - 3 After receiving a beautiful pass, Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) had a huge opportunity. He coolly unleashed a perfect low shot, which went in off the left post.
81' Min-Jae Kim comes off the pitch to be replaced by Eric Dier (Bayern Munich).
81' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
81' The ball goes out of play. Bayern Munich are awarded a corner kick.

81' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away. The referee points to the corner flag and Bayern Munich will take a corner.
80' The attendance for today's match is 30000.
78' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) replacing Lovro Majer.
75' Here comes a substitution. Michael Olise is given a rest as he is replaced by Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich).

74' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Daniel Siebert blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
73' So close! Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
71' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) picks up a yellow card.
71' Substitution. Patrick Wimmer is replaced by Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg).
70' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Daniel Siebert ignores the protests.
69' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle and it's Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
65' 2 - 2 Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) beats his own keeper to score a very unlucky own goal!
65' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is about to take a corner kick.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) comes onto the pitch for Sacha Boey.

64' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
64' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) serves up a nice cross, but Manuel Neuer punches the ball away.
61' A corner kick by Bayern Munich is thwarted by the well prepared Kamil Grabara (Wolfsburg).
61' Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Bayern Munich force their opponents to concede a corner.
60' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) is adjudged offside.
57' A loose ball is pounced on by Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the top right corner, but Kamil Grabara is alert and makes a comfortable save.
55' 2 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Patrick Wimmer is the provider as he slips the ball to Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) who simply steers it home from close range. It's 2:1.
55' It looks like Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) saw red with that tackle. Daniel Siebert won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
52' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
50' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the left post! A few inches to the right and it could have been a sweet goal!
50' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Kamil Grabara easily deals with the threat.
49' Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Daniel Siebert no option but to blow his whistle.
47' 1 - 1 Goal! Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Manuel Neuer into the bottom left corner.
47' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) is going to take the penalty!
46' Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Daniel Siebert didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
46' Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) makes a strong challenge and Daniel Siebert blows for a foul. Wolfsburg are given a huge opportunity to score - it's a penalty kick!
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
45+2' Daniel Siebert interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich). That's a free kick to Wolfsburg.
45+1' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
43' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Daniel Siebert has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

38' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) controls the ball from the free kick on the edge of the box and releases a strike that could have ended up in the roof of the net but for a magnificent save by Kamil Grabara.
37' It seemed like Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
36' Bayern Munich players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
31' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Daniel Siebert lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
30' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
30' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
29' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
28' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
26' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is out of play. Bayern Munich will have a throw-in.
25' Wolfsburg are seeing far more of the ball now.
21' 0 - 1 Goal! Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) scores after an assist by Sacha Boey that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 0:1.
17' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
17' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) was too forceful with his tackle and Daniel Siebert interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Bayern Munich have a free kick.
14' Bayern Munich fail to score from a corner as Kamil Grabara (Wolfsburg) leaps to collect the ball.

13' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though the header was directed to the left side of the goal, Kamil Grabara didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough. The linesman makes the right call and Bayern Munich will have a corner.
13' Bayern Munich work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
13' Kamil Grabara (Wolfsburg) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
12' The game is interrupted now, Kamil Grabara (Wolfsburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

11' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the right side of the goal, but Kamil Grabara pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. The ball is out of play. Bayern Munich win a corner kick.
11' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) commits a rough challenge and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul.
10' The foul by Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) was seen by Daniel Siebert who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
9' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

9' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Kamil Grabara inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the left side of the target, but was denied by a great save. The ball is out of play and Bayern Munich manage to earn a corner.
9' Bayern Munich are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
6' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
5' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.

4' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
2' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle after Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
2' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bayern Munich will have the kick-off.
Daniel Siebert will officiate today.
